title: It’s Not Always Crystal Clear: In-Pocket Analysis for Understanding Binding Site Microenvironment Properties
authors: Filipe Menezes; Tony Fröhlich; Lucy C. Schofield; Julian Cremer; Jon Agirre; Robbie P. Joosten; Raphael Bourgeas; Sihyun Sung; José Antonio Marquez; Garib Murshudov; Oliver Plettenburg; Michael Sattler; Grzegorz M. Popowicz
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍基于量子力学优化的In-Pocket方法，用于评估蛋白-配体结合界面的化学性质，虽涉及结合位点微环境分析，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA，且无TF-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法聚焦，仅部分方法可迁移。
abstract: Structural biology enabled key advances in biochemistry, drug discovery, and AI-driven three-dimensional structure modelling. Despite its importance, reliable and general computational tools for chemical validation of structural models remain limited, especially when small-molecule ligands are involved. This challenge is exacerbated when experimental resolution is insufficient to define interaction chemistry, leaving critical interpretations ambiguous. We introduce In-Pocket, a quantum mechanical optimisation method biased by experimental data that evaluates the chemical nature of protein-ligand binding interfaces. In-Pocket improves model quality, corrects chemically inconsistent structures, and identifies the energetically most favourable ligand-conformers within biomacromolecular complexes. The approach is generally applicable to a wide range of systems, including those containing transition metals. Benchmarking demonstrates that In-Pocket enhances the reliability of legacy and newly solved structures. With automated, user-friendly routine chemical validation, In-Pocket offers unique opportunities to improve the integrity of structural databases and impact diverse domains: from molecular biology to rational drug design and application of generative AI.
abstract_zh: 结构生物学推动了生物化学、药物发现和AI驱动的三维结构建模方面的关键进展。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但用于结构模型化学验证的可靠且通用的计算工具仍然有限，尤其是在涉及小分子配体时。当实验分辨率不足以定义相互作用化学时，这一挑战更加严峻，导致关键解释变得模糊不清。我们引入了In-Pocket，一种受实验数据偏置的量子力学优化方法，用于评估蛋白质-配体结合界面的化学性质。In-Pocket能提升模型质量、纠正化学不一致的结构，并识别生物大分子复合物中能量最有利的配体构象。该方法广泛适用于多种系统，包括含有过渡金属的系统。基准测试表明，In-Pocket增强了旧有和新解析结构的可靠性。凭借自动化、用户友好的常规化学验证，In-Pocket为提升结构数据库的完整性提供了独特机会，并影响多个领域：从分子生物学到理性药物设计及生成式AI的应用。
